dos.text: Use label/description/iconSrc or the default slot, never both, render() picks textTemplate() when label is set and falls back to <slot></slot> only when it's empty, so slotted custom content is silently dropped as soon as label has a value.

donts.text: Don't assume item.focus() focuses the item element itself, focus() only calls super.focus() when isFocusable (i.e. the item has a tabindex attribute, which moz-box-group sets in list-type groups); otherwise it delegates to the first or last slotted action element instead.
